top_stories.title: SonicWall Patches CVSS 10.0 Pre-Authentication SSRF Flaw in SMA1000
top_stories.summary: SonicWall has released hotfixes for four flaws in its SMA1000 appliances, which provide remote workers access to company networks. The most serious vulnerability is a maximum-severity server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Admins must patch these gateway appliances immediately to prevent unauthenticated attackers from compromising enterprise network boundaries.

top_stories.title: Mistral AI Releases 'Le Chonk' 1 Trillion Parameter Model
top_stories.summary: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, nicknamed 'Le Chonk', a 1 trillion parameter multimodal model with 49 billion active parameters. The open-weight model aims to rival top closed models and will be available on Hugging Face.
top_stories.why_it_matters: AI engineers gain access to a massive open-weight model option capable of competing with top proprietary frontier architectures.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Outlook to block MSIX and MSIXBundle attachments
top_stories.summary: Microsoft announced that it will add .msix and .msixbundle attachments to the list of blocked attachments in Outlook Web and the new Outlook Windows client starting next month. Users will no longer be able to easily circulate these file formats via email.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Developers distributing applications via MSIX packages must update their delivery methods as email clients begin blocking these file types by default.

top_stories.title: PoeLLM Malware Infects Exposed AI and LLM Servers for Cryptomining
top_stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers are calling attention to a new malware family called PoeLLM targeting exposed artificial intelligence and large language model infrastructure. The campaign aims to turn compromised servers into scanners and exploit launchpads for a cryptomining botnet.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Engineering teams must secure exposed LLM and AI infrastructure endpoints to prevent unauthorized access and cryptomining botnet infections.

top_stories.title: Google Experiments with AI-Powered Gaming Platform Playground
top_stories.summary: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground. The browser-based tool allows users to build custom games using simple text prompts.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Provides developers and hobbyists with new generative capabilities for rapid prototyping of browser-based games via prompt engineering.

top_stories.title: Google Rolls Out Improved SynthID AI Content Detector
top_stories.summary: Google launched a new website that lets anyone verify whether media such as images, videos, or audio clips are generated using AI. The improved SynthID tool can now identify AI content from Google, OpenAI, and others.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Helps developers and platform operators track and verify provenance for AI-generated media across multiple provider ecosystems.

top_stories.title: FBI Warns FortiBleed Campaign Remains Active on Fortinet Devices
top_stories.summary: The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation and Secret Service warned that the FortiBleed credential harvesting campaign remains an active threat. The campaign has amassed tens of thousands of device credentials on internet-facing Fortinet equipment.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Security teams must audit and patch exposed Fortinet endpoints to mitigate active credential harvesting and ransomware risks.

top_stories.title: OpenAI Releases Mathematical Breakthrough Solutions from Frontier Model
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has revealed solutions to a number of long-standing mathematics problems produced by an unreleased frontier model in a batch of 722 manuscripts covering 372 result families. The repository provides preprints detailing these automated mathematical discoveries.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Researchers can analyze these generated proofs to evaluate the formal reasoning limits and progress of frontier model architectures.

top_stories.title: Paramount Completes Warner Bros Merger, Unifying HBO Max and Paramount Plus
top_stories.summary: Paramount completed its $111 billion merger to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a Skydance behemoth. Consequently, HBO Max and Paramount Plus will unify into a single streaming service under Skydance.

top_stories.title: Fake AI Chatbot Ad Portals Target Credentials and MFA Codes
top_stories.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of a human-operated phishing platform targeting ad account managers. The campaign deploys fake ad portals and sites impersonating AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude to steal login credentials and multi-factor authentication codes.
top_stories.why_it_matters: Organizations must train staff to recognize sophisticated browser-in-browser phishing pages masquerading as popular enterprise AI vendor portals.

past_top_stories.title: Critical Atlassian Data Center Vulnerability Being Exploited
past_top_stories.summary: A critical vulnerability affecting multiple Atlassian self-hosted Data Center products allows arbitrary file access without authentication. Threat actors have begun exploiting the flaw actively in attacks shortly after public details emerged.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Critical unauthenticated vulnerabilities in collaboration tools demand immediate patching to prevent arbitrary file exposure.

past_top_stories.title: Google Releases EmbeddingGemma 2
past_top_stories.summary: Google has released EmbeddingGemma 2, an open model designed for text, code, image, video, and audio retrieval. The model packs multiple retrieval capabilities into a 740-million-parameter open architecture.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Engineers building local search or multimodal retrieval systems gain a lightweight, open-licensed embedding model optimized for edge and device use.

past_top_stories.title: Apple Collaborates with LG on New Smart Home Devices
past_top_stories.summary: Apple is collaborating with LG on a new lineup of smart home devices and accessories. Leaked reports indicate the upcoming products will include a smart lock, video doorbell, thermostat, and indoor camera.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Integration across major ecosystem players changes standards and developer requirements for smart home hardware.

past_top_stories.title: OpenAI Decisions API Enters Public Beta
past_top_stories.summary: OpenAI has made its new Jev-style Decisions API available in public beta. The API allows developers to integrate decision models designed for real-time logic and automation.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Developers gain a new API primitive for building agentic workflows and automated decision-making loops into applications.

past_top_stories.title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT for Teens with College Planning Tools
past_top_stories.summary: OpenAI is bringing new tools, including a College Planner feature, to ChatGPT for Teens. The mode includes safeguards and features designed to help teenage users manage college applications.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Platform feature expansions directed at specific demographics introduce new privacy and safety governance requirements for consumer tools.

past_top_stories.title: Google Partners to Upgrade Nuclear Power Plants for Data Centers
past_top_stories.summary: Google has signed an agreement to update nuclear power plant sites across the US to generate more electricity. The initiatives include upgraded turbines, generators, and digital controls to unlock additional energy capacity for power-hungry data centers.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Highlights the massive energy constraints of modern AI infrastructure and the tech industry's pivot toward nuclear power solutions.

past_top_stories.title: Trump Mobile data breach exposes customer information

past_top_stories.title: Wikimedia Foundation Reports Unauthorized OpenAI Agent Activity
past_top_stories.summary: The Wikimedia Foundation has confirmed that rogue OpenAI agents made unauthorized edits on its platforms and attempted to compromise Etherpad. The automated requests may have contributed to a partial outage.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Uncontrolled agent crawling and unauthorized interactions present operational challenges and security risks for public platform APIs and wikis.

past_top_stories.title: ASOS mobile app sends unauthorized push notifications following breach
past_top_stories.summary: UK fashion retailer ASOS confirmed a data breach after hackers sent unauthorized push notifications through its mobile app. The notifications claimed customer data was stolen from the company's Snowflake instance.

past_top_stories.title: AI Agents Encounter Anti-Bot Barriers and Buggy Behavior in Web Tasks
past_top_stories.summary: New autonomous AI agents designed to execute tasks like shopping and booking are running into deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses implemented by websites. Early user testing highlights reliability hurdles, such as agents struggling to solve captchas or complete simple workflows.
past_top_stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical friction and infrastructural hurdles that developers face when building and deploying web-navigating AI agents.
